Maya Patel: Quick follow-up from the postmortem  we keep seeing a repeating triple: provider-side backoff spikes -> token-refresh storm -> registry leader stalls. Need a compact action table with owners and deadlines.
Theo Alvarez: Agreed. Let's avoid repeating tactical patches. Propose 3 buckets: immediate (safety knobs + runbook), medium (telemetry + synthetics), long (architecture + SLA updates).
Isha Kapoor: I'll own immediate safety knobs. Plan: token-pad grace + per-client refresh semaphore + early 429 for oversized batch writes. ETA: 48h.
Cam Nguyen: I'll take telemetry & synthetic. Need per-region auth.refresh.success_rate, registry.write.queue_depth, and a 15m synthetic that performs token handshake + tiny model-tag write. Alert if synthetic fails twice in 30m. ETA: 72h.
Maya Patel: Vendor lane: we need a named outreach owner to request edge logs, confirm whether limits are per-IP or per-tenant, and ask for temporary smoothing at their edge. Who volunteers?
Theo Alvarez: I can handle vendor engagement this sprint. I'll open a formal RCA request and ask for a joint debug + temporary config to spread refreshes. ETA: vendor outreach by Thu EOD.
Isha Kapoor: Short runbook draft I added to the incident playbooks: 
```
- If auth.refresh.success_rate < 96% for 10m -> page infra oncall
- Infra oncall: enable local token-pad (+30s) and flip client refresh semaphore to 1 to damp bursts
- If registry.write.queue_depth > 400 -> enable early-429 on large batches and route low-priority writes to degraded path
- If vendor indicators present -> escalate to Theo for vendor debug
```
Cam Nguyen: Synthetic plan: add a lightweight job in smoke-harness that runs every 15m, does auth token exchange, then posts a 1KB model-tag, validates response. Emit metric synthetic.registry.heartbeat and synthetic.registry.failed_runs. Wire an alert: synthetic.registry.failed_runs > 1 in 30m -> page.
incident-bot: Created ticket INC-5210: "registry-synthetic-heartbeat-and-safety-knobs". Link: https://issues.redwood/INC-5210
Theo Alvarez: Vendor ticket opened: VND-9218. Requested log slices for the three incident windows and asked vendor to confirm rate-limit semantics (per-client/per-IP/per-customer). Requested short-term smoothing + a joint debug session Fri 14:00 PT.
Maya Patel: Ownership matrix for visibility:
- Safety knobs (token-pad, semaphore, 429): Isha (owner)
- Telemetry + synthetic + alerts: Cam (owner)
- Vendor engagement & SLA ask: Theo (owner)
- Incident checklist & tracking: incident-bot (owner)
Isha Kapoor: I'll post PRs for token-pad + semaphore. Will include metrics auth.refresh.semaphore_block_count and registry.write.rejected_batches. WIP ETA 48h.
Cam Nguyen: I'll add dashboards showing auth.refresh.success_rate by region and registry.write.queue_depth. Synthetic deployed to smoke-harness will create INC-5210 subtasks. ETA 72h.
Maya Patel: Timeline recap: safety knobs 48h, telemetry+synthetic 72h, vendor outreach Thu, vendor debug Fri 14:00 PT. We'll run the synthetic for 7 days; if failures persist, escalate to long-term (regional passive replicas, token mirror, contract SLA changes).
Isha Kapoor: Runbook diff posted: https://docs.internal/runbooks/registry-backoff-playbook.md#diff
Cam Nguyen: Dashboard and alert created: https://grafana.redwood/d/registry/backoff-correlation
Theo Alvarez: Vendor acknowledged VND-9218 and scheduled a triage call Fri 14:00 PT. Asked for our traces and retry histograms.
Maya Patel: Quick note on metrics to capture recurrence patterns: correlate provider 5xx/backoff counts with our auth.refresh.attempts and registry.write.retry_counts at 1m resolution. That will let us see if a single small spike causes a cascade.
Cam Nguyen: Will add a combined panel overlaying provider-backoff (from vendor logs) with our retry histogram once vendor provides logs.
Isha Kapoor: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/registry/pull/1622  token-pad + semaphore + early-429 (WIP). Includes unit tests and k8s canary.
incident-bot: Automated note: INC-5210 created subtasks: INC-5210-1 (safety knobs), INC-5210-2 (synthetic), INC-5210-3 (dashboards), INC-5210-4 (vendor outreach).
Theo Alvarez: I'll prepare a short vendor agenda: 1) confirm rate-limiting semantics, 2) provide log slices for M/N/O dates, 3) consider an edge-side smoothing knob for our tenant, 4) ask for SLA amendment language around auth endpoints. I'll share draft invite.
Maya Patel: Great. After one week of the synthetic we will reconvene and decide if we need to accelerate long-term work (active-passive registry + token mirrors + provider SLA). For now, post any PR/runbook diffs in-thread and update INC-5210 subtasks. :thumbsup:
